snippet.title: Ja 4 | Behind the Design | Nike
snippet.description:
Making of a Nightmare
Ja-Frame containment system, Cushlon 3.0 foam and a reengineered multidirectional traction pattern keep Ja locked in through every explosive move.

Don't Sleep on the Ja 4. Available 8.13.

Go behind the design of the Nike Ja 4 basketball shoe and discover how Ja Morant's explosive game inspired a silhouette built for lift, control and confidence. From the earliest design concepts to the finished performance product, every detail of the Ja 4
was engineered to support the speed, power and creativity that define Ja's style of play.

The Ja 4 delivers bouncy cushioning built to rise above the defense. A lightweight foam upper with textured haptic overlays provides durable support, while Cushlon 3.0 foam and a responsive sockliner help fuel explosive elevation. The JA-Frame containment system keeps athletes locked in during hard cuts and quick changes of direction, and a reengineered multidirectional traction pattern inspired by Ja's logo helps grip the court for explosive takeoffs and controlled landings.

Ja 4 Performance Benefits
• Explosive Lift
• Bouncy Court Feel
• Designed for Takeoff and Landing
• Elite Forward and Upward Traction

What's New in the Ja 4?
• Lightweight foam upper with textured haptic overlays adds durable support
• Cushlon 3.0 foam and a responsive sockliner bring a boost to your elevation
• Ja-logo inspired traction pattern grips and goes for easy takeoff
• Lateral JA-Frame keeps you locked in when you cut and change direction
The Nike Ja 4 is built for players who attack every possession with speed, creativity and confidence.

snippet.title: Yuto Horigome | What Are You Working On? (E32) | Nike
snippet.description:
After winning a historic gold medal in the first-ever skateboarding competition in the Olympics, and achieving one of the biggest feats in the sport at just 22 years old, where do you possibly go from there? For Yuto Horigome, it’s a question that he’s spent the last year trying to answer. It has meant going back to his roots – skating in parks and hanging with his hometown friends – and redefining what “success” really means, especially when sporting success comes with a price. As his star rises, and so does his fame, every podium placement might mean sacrificing another degree of freedom for a young skater still deeply passionate about the culture.
